facts.fact_text: The applicants attempted to participate in a public event in support of LGBTI people.
The public event in support of LGBTI people was authorised to take place on 12 October 2013 in St Petersburg.
The applicants were among the group of participants arrested by the police at the public event on 12 October 2013.

The applicants were among the group of participants arrested by the police at the public event on 12 October 2013.
